title: Natural polynomial closed-fibre localization equivalence
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n\ge0$, $P=R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and $Q$ a prime of $P$. Put $p=Q\cap R$, $k=\kappa(p)$, $B=P_Q$, and let $\varphi:R_p\to B$ be the canonical local map [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Put $I=\mathfrak m_{R_p}B$. There is a prime $Q_k$ of $k[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ contracting to $Q$ under coefficientwise mapping and a ring isomorphism $e:B/I\simeq k[x]_{Q_k}$ taking the class of $a/1$ to $\overline a/1$ for every $a\in P$.

source.place: 00SV first paragraph; 0H9M natural fibre-local-ring identification; polynomial scalar extension.

proof.text: Choose the fibre prime T contracting to Q using the fibre-prime correspondence. Polynomial scalar extension gives E: k tensor_R P = k[x] and E(j(a))=map(R to k)(a). Transport T to Qk by contraction along E inverse; the coefficient map contracts Qk to Q.
Apply the natural fibre-local-ring quotient equivalence to p and T. Transfer its source from the contracted prime T cap P to Q using equality, retaining the natural formula on a/1.

The maximal ideal of R_p is the image of p. The local map formula shows I=(pP)B. Compose the quotient equivalence for this ideal equality, the fibre quotient equivalence, and the localization of E. The composite has the stated formula.

theorem exists_polynomial_local_closedFiber_equiv
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) [Q.IsPrime] :
    let p := Q.comap (algebraMap R (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R))
    let φ := Localization.localRingHom p Q (algebraMap R (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) rfl
    let I := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p)).map φ
    ∃ (Qk : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin n) p.ResidueField)) (hQk : Qk.IsPrime),
      letI := hQk
      Qk.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R p.ResidueField)) = Q ∧
        ∃ e : (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ I) ≃+* Localization.AtPrime Qk,
          ∀ a : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R,
            e (Ideal.Quotient.mk I
              (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.AtPrime Q) a)) =
              algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) p.ResidueField) (Localization.AtPrime Qk)
                (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R p.ResidueField) a)
